# Generalize the lag-free snapshot overlay to unscoped reconcile passes

## Context
Bug f449 (seagreen-fortuitous-crayfish) fixes a narrow inbound stale-clobber window on the DC
rich-text lane by refreshing SCOPED bound-present keys via a lag-free direct GET (get_issue_by_rest)
before both differs and baseline advancement, so a post-write pass reading a stale JQL-search
snapshot cannot mirror a stale value back over local (the bound-field inbound differ,
inbound_differ._diff_jira_vs_local, is LEVEL-triggered with no baseline).

## Gap
The f449 overlay is guarded to SCOPED passes only, to bound the direct-GET volume. Full,
UNSCOPED production reconcile passes remain theoretically exposed to the same stale-inbound-clobber
if a pass runs while the search index still lags a very recent rebar write. In production, passes
are spaced far enough apart that the index normally catches up, so the practical risk is low --
but the level-triggered inbound path has no formal guard.

## Proposed work
Refresh only the AMBIGUOUS candidate keys on unscoped passes: keys where the search snapshot
presents local==baseline AND snapshot-remote!=baseline (i.e. a field that looks like a remote edit
but could be a stale echo of our own recent write). Direct-GET those keys, merge the mirrored
scalar fields into curr_snapshot, then arbitrate on the lag-free value. This bounds GET volume even
for unscoped passes (only genuinely-ambiguous keys) while closing the window for all passes.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Unscoped passes refresh ambiguous candidate keys (local==baseline AND remote!=baseline) via
      a lag-free GET before both differs and baseline advance.
- [ ] A held-out oracle proves an unscoped pass does not clobber local under a stale post-write
      snapshot, with bounded GET volume (only ambiguous keys refreshed).
- [ ] make lint && make typecheck && make test green.
compiled_state.title: Generalize lag-free snapshot overlay to unscoped reconcile passes (unblock inbound stale-clobber window)
